## DEFAULT_KEY_POLICY_CACHE_TTL_MS variable

Default lifetime of a cached per-key policy.

Short on purpose: a policy edit is a security-relevant change, and an operator tightening a key's policy should not have to wait long (or restart the server) for it to bite. [KeyPolicyResolver.invalidate()](./runtime.keypolicyresolver.invalidate.md) makes it immediate.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DEFAULT_KEY_POLICY_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5000
```
